bible.title: The Beads of Eldergrove
bible.kernel: A shrine elder hires the company to recover a missing set of ceremonial beads that will lead them through the passes.

cast.name: Angalanwen
cast.who: elder of the grove shrine who keeps the village rites and its beadwork
cast.want: to recover a stolen set of ceremonial beads and return them to their owner

cast.name: Ottglund of the Pass
cast.who: a wandering wolfman artisan who camps the mountain passes and trades carved trinkets
cast.want: to keep the beads and the carved bead that serves as a map to a hidden hoard

cast.name: Anselm
cast.who: a river-trader and fence who buys curios and sells information on the sly
cast.want: to keep or sell any beads he can fence rather than hand them over

bible.situation: The shrine's ceremonial beads were removed by Ottglund in the night because one bead hides a carved map bead. Ottglund intends to use that carved bead to find a buried hoard and will not admit theft. Anselm bought a clue piece and will only name Ottglund for a price. The pass-watch token shows the beads passed through the Greyspine route.
bible.goal: to recover a stolen set of ceremonial beads and return them to their owner
arc: Travel to the Eldergrove Shrine the client named to inspect the bead altar and the shrine keepers' reports → yields: a torn pass-token stamped by the pass-watch
Take the pass-token to Greyspine Pass to question the pass-watch and follow where their patrol points → yields: a tattered wolf-cloak snagged on a bramble
Track the wolf-cloak to Moss-crib Clearing and force answers from the fence who trades in oddments, paying his price → yields: word that Ottglund plans to return to Eldergrove at dusk
Wait at the Eldergrove Shrine the client named and confront Ottglund when he arrives. The company defeats or outbids him and hands the ceremonial beads to Angalanwen
tensions: Anselm will demand the wolf-cloak or a costly price before naming Ottglund
Ottglund refuses to surrender the beads and guards the hoard's secret fiercely
The pass-watch enforces patrol claims and can delay or extort the company
openDirections: With Ottglund in custody, press him for the buried hoard's site and bargain terms to retrieve it
Whether the company digs or not, Anselm and the pass-watch may press claims on any treasure recovered

shipped.title: Inspect the Eldergrove shrine reports
shipped.situation: Angalanwen unwrapped a cloth and set the empty bead cord on the table. To recover a stolen set of ceremonial beads and return them to their owner. She says the shrine keepers sent a brief report of theft at the bead altar and that the carved bead that marks a map is gone. Coin when the work is done. The matter smells of a payout worth a season of small jobs.
shipped.job: Travel to the Eldergrove Shrine and inspect the bead altar and the shrine keepers' reports
